name: @oge-ui/ai
description: Signal-based Angular AI components that work with any model: a natural-language grid assistant that turns "orders over 500 from last month, newest first" into validated sort, filter, grouping and column changes, with preview, apply and undo. Bring your own model — OpenAI-compatible (OpenAI, Azure, Ollama, vLLM), Anthropic, or your own backend; no hosted service, no row data sent.
author: kaya2m
